name: daintree.jira
description: First-party Jira Cloud issues provider — pick Jira issues for worktrees and use branch names that carry the issue key, while your code forge keeps pull requests and CI.
tagline: Jira Cloud issues for your worktrees, alongside your code forge

settings.label: Jira Cloud site URL
settings.description: Your Jira Cloud address, like https://acme.atlassian.net. Set it with your email and API token in Settings → Code forge, which checks all three.

settings.label: Atlassian account email
settings.description: The email address of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to. Set it with your site URL and API token in Settings → Code forge, which checks all three.

settings.label: Jira project key
settings.description: The key of the Jira project this project's issues live in, as it appears in issue keys (ENG for ENG-123).

credentialFields.label: API token
credentialFields.helpText: Create under Atlassian account → Security → API tokens.
